Definition: vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard
BiblicalUsage: 1) strength, power, might; 1a) human strength; 1b) strength (of angels); 1c) power (of God); 1d) strength (of animals); 1e) strength, produce, wealth (of soil); 2) a small reptile, probably a kind of lizard, which is unclean; 2a) perhaps an extinct animal, exact meaning is unknown
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
